focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期临近，中国出口企业需加快碳数据合规布局
focus.summary: 欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征税阶段。近期欧盟委员会发布过渡期报告规则修订草案，对进口商申报隐含碳排放的数据质量提出更严格要求。中国钢铁、铝、化肥等行业出口企业面临碳成本传导压力，需尽快建立产品级碳排放核算体系，并关注默认值适用条件与核查机构资质要求，以降低未来税负与合规风险。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会气候行动总司 · 2026.09.21
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transition Nears End: Chinese Exporters Urged to Accelerate Carbon Data Compliance
focus.summary_en: The EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period will conclude by the end of 2026, with definitive taxation beginning in 2027. The European Commission recently released a draft amendment to reporting rules, imposing stricter data quality requirements on importers' embedded emissions declarations. Chinese exporters in steel, aluminium, and fertiliser sectors face carbon cost pass-through pressure. Companies should establish product-level carbon accounting systems and monitor default value conditions and verifier qualification requirements to mitigate future tax burdens and compliance risks.

case.title: 新加坡国际商事法庭承认中国法院商事判决，跨境债权执行路径进一步畅通
case.summary: 近期，新加坡国际商事法庭（SICC）在一宗中资企业跨境债务纠纷中，依据普通法原则承认并执行了中国法院的商事判决，认定中国法院具有适当管辖权且程序公正。该案为《选择法院协议公约》框架外的判决互认提供了实务参考，表明中新两国在互惠原则下承认判决的可能性增加。出海企业可在合同中约定新加坡管辖或仲裁，并保留中国法院判决作为备用执行依据，以提升跨境债权回收效率。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际商事法庭 · 2026.09
case.title_en: SICC Recognises Chinese Commercial Judgment, Easing Cross-Border Debt Enforcement
case.summary_en: The Singapore International Commercial Court (SICC) recently recognised and enforced a Chinese commercial judgment in a cross-border debt dispute involving a Chinese enterprise, applying common law principles and finding that the Chinese court had proper jurisdiction and followed fair procedures. This case offers practical guidance for judgment recognition outside the Hague Choice of Court Convention, signalling growing receptivity under the reciprocity principle. Chinese outbound enterprises may consider designating Singapore jurisdiction or arbitration while retaining Chinese judgments as fallback enforcement bases to enhance cross-border debt recovery.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区推出跨境数据流动便利化新规，涉外企业数据出境路径再优化
policy.summary: 广东省近日发布粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化措施，在河套深港科技创新合作区、横琴粤澳深度合作区等地试点扩大数据出境负面清单管理范围，允许符合条件的企业通过安全评估、标准合同或认证等多元路径实现数据合规出境。新规特别明确科研数据、金融数据及跨境电商数据的分类管理要求，并设立跨境数据流动服务中心提供一站式申报辅导，有助于降低企业合规成本。
policy.source: 来源：广东省政务服务数据管理局 · 2026.09
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Introduces New Cross-Border Data Flow Facilitation Rules
policy.summary_en: Guangdong Province recently issued measures to facilitate cross-border data flows in the Greater Bay Area, piloting an expanded negative list approach in the Hetao Shenzhen-Hong Kong Science and Technology Innovation Cooperation Zone and the Hengqin Guangdong-Macao Deep Cooperation Zone. Eligible enterprises may transfer data abroad through security assessments, standard contracts, or certification. The rules clarify classification requirements for research, financial, and cross-border e-commerce data, and establish a one-stop service centre for filing support, helping reduce compliance costs.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Provincial Government Service and Data Administration · 2026.09

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规扩围，中企须重构跨境交易合规架构
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部外国投资委员会（CFIUS）近期扩大对外投资审查范围，将半导体、人工智能、量子计算等敏感领域的境外投资纳入申报要求，并强化对通过第三地转投资的穿透审查。中国出海企业应重新评估现有及拟议跨境交易架构，在交易文件中加入CFIUS相关陈述保证与赔偿条款，并考虑引入“反向分手费”机制。同时，建议提前进行自愿申报可行性分析，避免因强制申报触发交易终止风险。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球 · iGlobal Law 研究部 · 2026.09.21
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: Expanded US Outbound Investment Screening Requires Rethinking Cross-Border Deal Structures
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Treasury's CFIUS has expanded its outbound investment screening to cover sensitive sectors such as semiconductors, AI, and quantum computing, with heightened scrutiny of third-country transshipment structures. Chinese outbound enterprises should reassess existing and proposed cross-border transactions, incorporate CFIUS-related representations, warranties, and indemnities into deal documents, and consider reverse break fees. Early voluntary filing feasibility analyses are recommended to avoid deal termination risks triggered by mandatory filings.
